nodes.name: Call Gemini AI
nodes.notes: Configure: Create an 'HTTP Query Auth' credential named 'Gemini API Key' with the field 'value' set to your Google AI Studio API key. Get a free key at https://aistudio.google.com/

meta.description: Nexrow AI Milestone Verification Workflow. Analyzes freelancer proof-of-work submissions against client requirements using Google Gemini AI. Returns { satisfied: bool, reason: string } to the frontend, which then auto-releases the Algorand payment if satisfied.
setupInstructions: 1. Import this JSON into your n8n instance via Workflows > Import.
2. Create an 'HTTP Query Auth' credential in n8n: Name it 'Gemini API Key', set Field Name to 'key', and Value to your Google AI Studio API key (get one free at https://aistudio.google.com/).
4. Copy the webhook URL (e.g. https://your-n8n.com/webhook/verify-milestone) and set VITE_N8N_WEBHOOK_URL=<your-url> in your .env file.
